name: BAPIL demonstration question set
description: Small bilingual question set over BAPIL's own publications, used to show that the evaluation harness works end to end. It is not BanglaPolicyQA and says nothing about performance on the national corpus. Gold passages are identified by document and section heading; a question may have several acceptable sources.
